prompt: Our Islamic ethics newsletter team needs a full content package based on the article about al-amr al-mutlaq sitting in our workspace. We want to publish content about it on social media and log it in our editorial calendar. Please produce a single file called `content_package.md` that contains: (1) a structured summary of the article, (2) three ready-to-publish social media post drafts that are structurally different from one another so we avoid duplicate-looking content, and (3) an archive entry so the editorial team can track this piece for later scheduling. The file should be complete enough that any team member can pick it up and publish without needing to dig through the source material again.
